answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 9 epochs old, anchored at a harbor checkpoint. The river chain is verified at intake and thread publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 9 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 133 dollars and 11 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
